DroneBioR: Reproducible Drone Biomass Workflows for Multispectral Imagery

Source: R/zzz.R
DroneBioR-package.Rd

DroneBioR wraps external photogrammetry engines (OpenDroneMap, WebODM, Pix4Dmapper, Agisoft Metashape) to produce orthomosaics, DSM/DTM, dense point clouds and meshes, then provides the scientific layer in R: alpha and no-data masking, radiometric scaling to reflectance, vegetation indices, canopy height models, point-cloud ROI analysis, individual tree candidate detection, field sample extraction, baseline biomass models, and a Shiny application for interactive exploration.

Reading the products of external engines

DroneBioR can read products from any photogrammetry engine that produces standard formats:

  • GeoTIFF orthomosaics (multi-band MicaSense layout, with optional alpha);

  • GeoTIFF DSM and DTM rasters;

  • LAS / LAZ / COPC point clouds (PDAL/lidR optional);

  • PLY point clouds and meshes;

  • OBJ textured models.

Engines

  • OpenDroneMap (ODM) via Docker: see run_odm_project().

  • WebODM, Pix4Dmapper, Agisoft Metashape: just point DroneBioR at the output folder produced by those tools.
